about: Amendment 1 to concentration_test (reports/predictions/2026-10-15_prediction_concentration-amendment.md). The original predictions.json is unchanged. The trigger-local control failed its filed rule: do-nothing's CI-masked P(o) was 0.535 (needed < 0.498) because the frozen Gamma reads the fine-tuned activations and its gates alone move the component model towards `o`. This amendment fixes the gates to W0: Gamma's g is computed from the W0 model's activations, so only the components can carry the update. Filed before the amended measure was run.

predictions.claim: The six labelled subcomponents carry the learned behaviour under the original gating.
predictions.measure: siblings arm, W0-gated CI-masked P(o) at the trigger
predictions.prediction: pass (the windows were chosen where 2359 has g > 0.5 at W0)

predictions.claim: As A1 for the top-10 arm.
The diffuse Adam update is not carried by the components Gamma gates on at W0.

setup.control: do-nothing (target W0 + dW of adam_all, components at W0) under W0 gates must give P(o) < 0.5 x target (it is W0's own CI-masked model, 0.0045 in concentration.json), else unscorable
setup.reported: W0-gated numbers for every arm; mean g at the trigger (W0) of each moved subcomponent in the masked arms; W0-gated KL at the trigger of W0's own decomposition is 0.519 (concentration.json), the baseline imperfection at the trigger
setup.state_gated: as the original trigger_local (g from the state's activations), recomputed for comparison
setup.states: each arm's selected run retrained with the same lr, seed and recipe; held-out P(o) at step 30 must match concentration.json within 0.01 (logged)
setup.w0_gated: g = frozen Gamma on the W0 model's activations over the held-out windows; component model with the state's components, masks = g, Delta excluded; target = the state's model. Mean P(o) at the trigger, KL(target || model) at the trigger and at the other 40 positions
